newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Mandela trip to Middle East under review.
newsitem.headline: Mandela trip to Middle East under review.

text.p: President Nelson Mandela's scheduled trip to the Middle East next month is being reviewed, a South African foreign affairs spokesman said on Friday.
Two weeks ago the foreign affairs department said the trip was on hold pending progress in reviving the flagging Middle East peace process.
"The situation is under review," the spokesman said. He declined to elaborate.
Mandela's office announced the planned visit early in September, saying the president would leave on November 4 for Israel, the Palestinian self-rule territories, Jordan and Egypt.
Mandela has twice postponed scheduled visits to Israel, first planned for August and then October.
